findings.text: During second CNN reduction, committed6 remains readable while Incoming contributions occupy a separate dock. At650ms on phone a carrier briefly overlaps one duplicate Incoming digit; the original weighted contribution6 and committed6 remain clear. This arrival convergence is nonblocking.

KV cache identities and Request A/Retained ownership remain readable at390px. Current-pass projections, read copies, and emitted tokens remain visibly separate; reading does not evict the persistent cache.

The sampled bounded carriers avoid the Generated tokens heading and preserve stationary source/destination identity. Light and dark scenes show no material text clipping, numerical wrapping, figure overflow, or retained-value occlusion in this coverage.

limitations: This is simulated reviewer inspection, not testing with actual students; no learning gain is established.
Only two base-case pilots and four selected transitions were deeply reviewed; no variant coverage is claimed.
Real document.hidden could not be induced by this headless environment. Hidden-page pause remains inconclusive; no synthetic visibility event was substituted.
At390px figures require normal page scrolling; controls and the entire scene are not simultaneously visible.
Timed snapshots sample three moments, not every animation instant. All48final timed captures were manually inspected.
Review applies only to the specified cleanbuild hashes; earlier pilot report remains separate.
